_comment: Team sizes (V, 2026-10-02): 4 monsters for most content, 3 for special content (PvP, some PvE), 5 by difficulty in the great dungeons, never more than 18 (grindstone dungeons take 18 and gem dungeons 6, V 2026-10-04; the world boss is its own rule in world_boss.json). The first rule that matches a stage wins (`kind`, `difficulty`, `min_index` are optional filters); `special_stages` forces a size for one stage (V picks the special PvE ones later). PLACEHOLDER thresholds.
